dedupe_keys.name: 25mbps broadband service availability urban vs rural of households by province and territory 2016

description: 25Mbps Broadband service availability – Urban vs. rural (% of households), by province and territory, 2016 is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission | Conseil de la radiodiffusion et des télécommunications canadiennes. This table shows the percentage of Canadian households in large, medium, and small population centres, as well as in rural areas, that can access 25 Mbps broadband services in each province and territory. Small population centres are considered to have populations of between 1,000 and 29, 000. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission | Conseil de la radiodiffusion et des télécommunications canadiennes. Its tags are Largeur de bande, Vitesse Internet, Télécommunications, Internet, Large bande. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, TXT, XLSX. The portal shows 2018-04-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
